name: video-timeline
title: VideoTimeline
description: A video editor's timeline: a ruler you scrub, lanes with headers (hide, mute, lock), clips you drag along a track, among a magnetic track's clips (which make room) or to another track, trim handles on both edges, a playhead, snapping to edges and the playhead, frame-accurate edits, pinch or ⌘-wheel zoom, keyboard nudging and drops from a media library. Controlled: one onChange per gesture, so each edit is one undo step.
